atoms.text: Every number from 1 to 99 is made from <t-blue>tens</t-blue> and <t-yellow>ones</t-yellow>.
The <t-blue>first digit</t-blue> of the number describes how many <t-blue>tens</t-blue> there are in the number.

example.a: There are <t-blue>4 tens</t-blue> in the number <t-blue>4</t-blue>7.
example.sound: There are 4 tens in the number 47.

atoms.text: The <t-yellow>second digit</t-yellow> of the number describes how many <t-yellow>ones</t-yellow> there are in the number.

example.a: There are <t-yellow>7 ones</t-yellow> in the number 4<t-yellow>7</t-yellow>.
example.sound: There are 7 ones in the number 47.
